reviews.review:
Back 4 Blood is the 2021 Receipient of Niko Bacon's Worst of 2021 Award! 

-TLDR: I'd rather binge drink than play this game again


I like many was extremely hyped for this game as a L4D fan. But this game dropped the ball.... down a tentacle infested sewer like its ending. The deck building was a flawed attempt as many were roadblocked into supply lines and really felt more like i was dealing with Lootbox luck over anything else. The story, honestly i have no recollection of it was that dull i couldnt even guess a character name vs older games like Dead Island and Dying Light. Theres just no real replay value or anything, it felt like a nothing game for the Excessive price tag. Im glad i didnt bother with the DLC.

The few things over L4D i can say for this game is i did like the ability to modify weapon parts to better suit ones playstyle. But aside from that it fell short of any expectations.

The game also runs great on Steam Deck but this game could have been way better. What I loved about L4D besides the zombies is the characters. All the L4D characters had soul and felt flushed out. The conversations between them while shooting zombies would make you laugh and overall just like them. The "cleaners" in this game are basically flat and uninteresting for the most part. While the zombies in this game are just as interesting as L4D both games suffer from lack of weapons. This is the zombie apocalypse right here in the USA, guns should be everywhere and the variety should be high. It looks like they are trying to add to the game with DLC so maybe this game will grow into itself. 

If you were left for dead by the lack of zombie content I guess you can always come back for blood and play this game. I recommend this game only if it's on sale and you and your friends get it together, otherwise just hold off. 7/10
